_readme: Knowledge base behind the advice SMS. The app does NOT read this file: it sends the texts of data/templates.json (keys adv_leaf_rust, adv_phoma, adv_healthy). This file records what each short SMS is based on and where it comes from, so it can be reviewed. 'sources' are ids of data/sources.json; an empty list means the item still has no source. status: draft -> reviewed (an extension officer or NaCORI checked it) -> approved. Do not add doses or product names before a local review.

recognise.text: Orange or yellow powder, mostly under the leaf; pale yellow patches on the top side.

do.text: Pick off the badly hit leaves and bury them.
Prune to open the bush: more air, shorter leaf wetness, and sprays can reach the inside of the canopy.
Weed the plot and keep the recommended spacing between trees.
Add manure or compost so the trees stay strong.
Ask the extension agent about a copper fungicide (the agent chooses product and timing).

avoid.text: Do not buy or mix chemicals without the agent's advice.

escalate_when: The farmer answers 'worse' at the 3-day follow-up (template followup_worse).
Many trees are affected or leaves are falling widely.

longer_term.text: Replant with rust-resistant varieties when renewing the plot.

recognise.text: Dark brown to black patches on leaves; young leaves and shoot tips turn black and die back.
Appears in cold, wet or windy weather, at higher altitude.

do.text: Cut off the black, dying tips and burn them.
Shelter young trees and nurseries from cold wind (windbreaks).
Prune and space the trees so the canopy dries faster after rain or mist.
Ask the extension agent about a preventive copper spray in cool, humid periods.

avoid.text: Avoid wounding the trees when pruning or weeding: wounds let the fungus in.
Do not over-apply nitrogen; keep fertilisation balanced.

escalate_when: The farmer answers 'worse' at the 3-day follow-up (template followup_worse).
Dieback reaches branches, not only the tips.
The classifier confuses it with leaf rust: ask template clarify_rust_phoma, then the agent.

recognise.text: Leaves green, glossy and uniform, with no spots, patches or powder.

do.text: Check under the leaves every week and text back if spots or powder appear.

escalate_when: Marks or powder appear: describe them again (the app will classify the new message).

other.note: No advice is ever given for 'other' or 'unknown' (see ai/analyze.py): one clarifying question, then a field agent (template unsure). Pests, berries, stems, roots, wilt, nutrients and water are not covered by the model (see docs/datasheet.md).
